name: context-check
description: A local-first contextual typo checker for VS Code workspaces and GitHub review.

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:extension && npm run package:extension && npm run build:vscode && npm run package:vscode && npm run build:site && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.test:extension: npm run build:extension && xvfb-run -a node scripts/test-extension.mjs
scripts.test:vscode: npm run build:vscode && npm run package:vscode && xvfb-run -a node scripts/test-vscode.mjs
